mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical Stochastic Momentum Index crossing zero identifies a change in whether double-smoothed close location lies above or below the midpoint of its recent high-low envelope; follow the new side for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when SMI crosses strictly above zero; short when it crosses strictly below zero
mechanism.why_distinct: Blau SMI double-smooths both close displacement from the rolling high-low midpoint and the envelope width before taking their ratio. SMI Ergodic instead smooths signed close changes relative to absolute close changes; ordinary stochastic uses unsmoothed close location. This candidate uses no volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse double-smoothed range-midpoint balance crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.range_window: highest completed high and lowest completed low over ten uninterrupted bars
features.relative_range: completed close minus rolling high-low midpoint
features.range_width: rolling highest high minus rolling lowest low, strict positive
features.double_ema: two causal consecutive EMA(3) recursions with alpha=0.5, each seeded from its first finite input and emitted after three uninterrupted inputs
features.event: current finite nonzero SMI sign differs from immediately prior finite nonzero sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official TradingView SMI(10,3) zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no K/D length, EMA initialization, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: William Blau Stochastic Momentum Index as implemented and documented by TradingView
external_basis.fixed_definition: %K length 10; relativeRange=close-(highestHigh+lowestLow)/2; highestLowestRange=highestHigh-lowestLow; each receives two consecutive EMA(3); SMI=200*smoothed relativeRange/smoothed range; zero divides positive from negative close location
external_basis.selection_use: official formula, published default K=10 and D=3, and zero direction only; no optional SMI signal EMA, incidence, or outcomes
